CheckTitle: Security Groups with all Memcached port (11211) open to the internet
Description: Security Groups have been found to allow access from the internet to Memcached port.
Risk: An open Memcached port (11211) can be abused for large-scale amplification DDoS attacks and may allow extraction of cached sensitive data.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure security groups do not allow any access from the internet to ports, unless required as per business requirements.
